identity.real_world_identity_notes: The exact AC package is ferrari_312t. The 1975 312T is Ferrari's transverse-gearbox Formula One car and is distinct from the earlier 312B3(T) and later 312T evolutions.

Ferrari's official 312T history and a period technical report identify the car and its 1975 five-speed manual control arrangement; the local observation identifies the exact package.

claims.basis: Ferrari's official 312T history and a period technical report identify the car and its 1975 five-speed manual control arrangement; the local observation identifies the exact package.

Ferrari's technical summary gives five forward speeds plus reverse. The period report describes a short gear lever operating a gear gate; no paddle or sequential actuation is described for this 1975 configuration. The reviewed car is a manually actuated H-pattern five-speed; under the project's derivation rules a clutch is required to pull away from rest. Manual blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Automatic blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Throttle lift is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. Automatic cut is modeled only for upshifts in this schema.
